India’s Most Authentic Rajasthani Folk Band for Premium Events

The Chokhi Vini Project Folk Band is the performing wing of Krishna Music School Pushkar. For over 17 years we’ve shared Rajasthan’s musical traditions with global audiences—performing at 500+ weddings, 100+ international retreats, and major cultural festivals including the Pushkar International Camel Fair. Led by master vocalist Vini Devda, we blend authentic folk classics, devotional music, and modern fusion (Sufi & Bollywood) with integrated Kalbeliya dance performances.

What We Perform

🎵 Traditional Rajasthani Folk (40%)

  • Kesariya Balam — Welcome song for guests
  • Padharo Mhare Des — Invitation to Rajasthan
  • Ghoomar — Royal Rajasthani dance song
  • Wedding Songs — Saso Ki Mala, Banna Banni, Bidaai

🙏 Devotional & Spiritual (25%)

  • Krishna Bhajans — Hare Krishna, Radhe Radhe, Govind Bolo
  • Guru & Meera Bhajans — Meera ke Pad, Kabir Dohas
  • Sufi Melodies — Khwaja Mere Khwaja, light qawwali
  • Mantra Chanting — Gayatri, Om Namah Shivaya

🎸 Fusion & Modern (20%)

  • Folk + Bollywood — Ghoomar (Padmaavat), Laal Ishq
  • World Music — Jazz-folk fusion, guitar collaborations
  • Interactive — Teach Ghoomar steps, audience participation

Frequently Asked Questions

What makes you different from other folk bands?

17+ years experience, trained under master folk musicians, 500+ events performed, unique 180-year-old temple venue access, integrated Kalbeliya dance troupe, bilingual hosting for international guests, and 4.8+/5 rating from verified reviews.

Can you perform outside Pushkar?

Absolutely! We regularly perform across Rajasthan (Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer) and pan-India (Delhi, Mumbai, Goa). Travel costs apply beyond 50km from Pushkar.

Do you only perform traditional folk?

No! We’re highly versatile: Traditional Rajasthani folk (40%), Devotional/spiritual (25%), Fusion/modern (20%), Interactive segments (15%). We customize based on your audience.

Can international guests enjoy the performance?

Yes! 70% of our bookings are for international audiences. We provide bilingual hosting (English/Hindi), explain cultural context, and use universal language of music. Guests from 60+ countries rated us 4.8+/5.

What’s included in wedding packages?

Wedding packages include traditional welcome songs (Kesariya Balam), banna-banni songs, mehendi geet, baraat procession music, bidaai songs, and interactive segments where guests learn traditional dance steps. Fully customizable.

Do dancers perform with real snakes?

Our Kalbeliya dance is inspired by snake charmer traditions. We offer: (1) Traditional dance without live snakes (most popular), or (2) Dance with trained, non-venomous snakes handled by licensed professionals (additional fee, venue approval required).

How far in advance should we book?

Minimum 3 weeks. Recommended 6-8 weeks for weddings. Peak season (Oct-Feb) and Pushkar Camel Fair dates book 10-12 weeks out. Weekend dates fill fastest.

Do you offer discounts for multi-day weddings?

Yes! Multi-day packages (3+ performances) receive 15-20% discount. You get consistent team across all events and varied repertoire each evening.

Krishna Music School teaches harmonium, Indian singing, bhajan and kirtan, Hindustani classical vocal and tabla. Classes are live and one-to-one, online worldwide or in person at the historic Rangji Temple in Pushkar, Rajasthan, India. Founded in 2008 by musician and teacher Vini Devda.
